_comment: The hand-authored half of the ADR-0019 presentation catalogue, in the SOURCE
locale (en). ADR-0018 CB-4: the catalogue ships EMBEDDED IN THE ARTIFACT.
Every entry here OVERRIDES the seed the build script derives from the frozen
registry's `condition` field. The seed exists so LT-3c's completeness rule is
satisfied by construction for all 201 codes; this file is where a code gets
user-facing copy that is a real sentence rather than a technical condition.
LT-4: every value is a WHOLE PATTERN. Placeholders are named ICU-style
`{evidence_key}` and are bound to that code's REGISTRY-DECLARED evidence
fields. No string is assembled from a reason_code, an i18n key or an enum
name; the build script rejects a placeholder the registry does not declare.
LT-3b/LT-3c: `next_action` is an object with a MANDATORY `neutral` and
optional `variants`. An empty platform_ctx resolves to `neutral` and never to
the host's platform. A variant without a neutral fails the build.

domain_summary.NET: TwinVPN could not reach the network it needs.
domain_summary.NAT: TwinVPN could not open a direct path through this network's address translation.
domain_summary.RELAY: TwinVPN could not use a relay for this connection.
domain_summary.AUTH: TwinVPN could not confirm this device's or the other device's identity.
domain_summary.CRYPTO: TwinVPN could not complete the encrypted handshake with the other device.
domain_summary.PROTO: TwinVPN and the other side do not agree on a protocol they can both speak.
domain_summary.POLICY: A protection rule stopped this traffic.
domain_summary.DNS: TwinVPN could not resolve names the way its policy requires.
domain_summary.ROUTE: TwinVPN could not program this device's routing the way it needs to.
domain_summary.PLATFORM: The operating system refused something TwinVPN needs.
domain_summary.CONTROL: TwinVPN could not reach or trust the coordination service.
domain_summary.INTERNAL: TwinVPN hit a defect in itself.
domain_summary.MGMT: The local management interface refused this request.
domain_summary.STORE: TwinVPN could not read or write its local encrypted store.
domain_summary.UPDATE: TwinVPN could not complete an update step.

domain_next_action.NET: Check this device's network connection, then try again.
domain_next_action.NAT: Try a different network, or let TwinVPN fall back to a relay.
domain_next_action.RELAY: Wait and try again; if it keeps happening, report it with a diagnostic bundle.
domain_next_action.AUTH: Check that this device is still paired and has not been revoked.
domain_next_action.CRYPTO: Try again; if it keeps happening, re-pair the two devices.
domain_next_action.PROTO: Update TwinVPN on both devices so they share a supported version.
domain_next_action.POLICY: Review the protection settings for this device.
domain_next_action.DNS: Check this device's DNS settings, then try again.
domain_next_action.ROUTE: Check for other VPN or virtual-network software on this device.
domain_next_action.PLATFORM: Grant TwinVPN the permission it asked for in this device's system settings.
domain_next_action.RESOURCE: Reduce the number of connected devices, or free resources on this device.
domain_next_action.CONTROL: Check this device's internet connection; existing connections keep working.
domain_next_action.INTERNAL: Report this with a diagnostic bundle.
domain_next_action.MGMT: Check that you are allowed to run this command on this device.
domain_next_action.STORE: Restart TwinVPN. If it keeps happening, report it with a diagnostic bundle.
domain_next_action.UPDATE: Try the update again, or install the latest release manually.

_comment_remediation_class: ADR-0019 §11.13 oracle 1: 'Three non-empty parts are produced. Where
So a code an Owner cannot act on still gets a part 3, and it is sourced from
the SHAPE of the remediation rather than from the code. That is the same
reason ADR-0018 F-4 puts `remediation_class` in the resolved attribute set:
'so a surface can pick an affordance for a code it has never seen'. One
sentence per `twinvpn.v1.RemediationClass` value; the build script requires

remediation_class.NONE: Nothing to do. This is information about what TwinVPN did, not a problem you need to fix.
remediation_class.WAIT: Nothing to do. TwinVPN is already retrying and will recover on its own.
remediation_class.LOCAL_ACTION: This needs an action on this device.
remediation_class.PEER_ACTION: This needs an action on the other device, not on this one.
remediation_class.POLICY_CHANGE: This needs a protection setting or a permission to be changed.
remediation_class.UPDATE_REQUIRED: This needs TwinVPN to be updated on this device or on the other one.
remediation_class.NETWORK_CHANGE: This network is the obstacle. Try a different network, or ask whoever runs this one.
remediation_class.PERMISSION_GRANT: This needs a permission to be granted in this device's system settings.
remediation_class.REPORT_DEFECT: This is a defect in TwinVPN. Create a diagnostic report and share it with support.

reason.internal_core_panic.summary.text: TwinVPN caught a defect in itself and stopped the affected component before it could do harm. Your protection rules are still in place.

reason.internal_invariant_violated.summa.text: TwinVPN found one of its own internal rules broken ({invariant}) and stopped rather than continuing in an uncertain state.

reason.internal_unexpected_state.summary.text: TwinVPN was asked to do something that its current state does not allow.

reason.internal_buffer_overflow.summary.text: TwinVPN's local diagnostic ledger filled up and dropped {dropped} of the oldest entries.

reason.internal_missing_reason.summary.text: A component reported a problem without saying what it was, which is itself a defect.

reason.internal_abi_version_mismatch.sum.text: The TwinVPN application and its core were built for different internal interfaces, so they cannot run together.

reason.internal_abi_version_mismatch.nex.neutral: Reinstall TwinVPN as a single package so the application and its core match.

variants.text: Install matching versions of the TwinVPN packages; a partial upgrade left the application and its core out of step.
Install matching versions of the TwinVPN packages; a partial upgrade left the application and its core out of step.

reason.policy_killswitch_engaged.summary.text: Protected traffic is blocked because no authorized secure path exists.

reason.policy_killswitch_engaged.next_ac.neutral: Wait for reconnection, or disconnect deliberately by running 'twinvpn session disconnect'. Disconnecting does not unblock traffic; only disarming the kill switch does.

reason.platform_vpn_permission_denied.su.text: This device has not given TwinVPN permission to create a VPN connection.

reason.platform_vpn_permission_denied.ne.neutral: Grant TwinVPN permission to create a VPN connection in this device's system settings.

Open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, and allow the TwinVPN system extension. You may need to restart.
